w_soaked: The track is soaked. Full wets.
w_water: Too much standing water for inters.
w_wetshot: The wets are overheating. Time to change.
w_dryline: There's a dry line now. Slicks!
w_sc: Safety car! Cheap stop, box now.
w_second: We still need a second compound.
battery: The battery is empty. Switch to harvest for a lap?
reminder: Reminder. We must use a second dry compound. Box this lap, or take a penalty.
sc: Safety car, safety car. No overtaking.
vsc: Virtual safety car. Hold your pace.
scin: Safety car in this lap. Get ready for the restart.
stopped: The rain has stopped. The track will start to dry.
radar1: Radar shows rain in about one lap.
radar2: Radar shows rain in about two laps.
puncture: Puncture! Bring it back to the pits.
contact: Contact! Keep it going if you can.
out: We're out. The car has stopped. Sorry.
won: We won the race! Brilliant job, brilliant.
nopoints: No points today. We'll go again.
k_team: You run two cars. Use the tabs on the pit wall to switch between them.
k_chase: You're within a second of the car ahead. Attack and boost now!
k_defend: The car behind is close. Defend!
k_tyre: The tyres are fading. Time to think about a stop.
k_harvest: Clear air. Harvest the battery, for the next fight.
k_push: Last lap. Push with both cars!
k_calm: Nobody close ahead. Back to neutral, save the tyres.
o_swap: Team orders. Let your teammate through.
o_hold: Hold positions. No fighting each other.
k_swap: Your teammate behind is on fresher tyres. Swap places.
k_hold: Our two cars are fighting each other. Hold positions?
d_lockup: Locked up there. A touch earlier on the brakes.
d_wide: Ran wide. Easy on the entry.
d_spin: Spun it! Careful, it's slippery out there.
d_notes: Good work. The strategist has some notes for you.
u_mate_behind: Your teammate is right behind you.
u_pulling: The car ahead is pulling away.
u_tyre_worn: The tyres are wearing now. Look after them.
u_bat_low: Battery is low. Harvest where you can.
u_pace_slow: We need a bit more pace.
u_rival_pit_b: The car behind has boxed. Watch the undercut.
u_mate_pass: Your teammate is coming through. Let them by.
c_auto: Okay, you make the calls now.
c_manual: Copy. I'll take the calls from here.
